stages.name: Project Initialization

criteria.description: Existing project metadata and revision identity are recorded.

stages.name: Requirements and Specifications
stages.purpose: Record sourced requirements and explicit acceptance criteria.
required_inputs: Engineer-supplied requirements, acceptance criteria and attributable evidence
expected_outputs: Traceable stage outputs and acceptance/review findings

criteria.description: An explicitly supplied numerical acceptance check has current, intact evidence. It does not grant engineering approval.
